note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: Read-Host 'Owner: episodes 1-6 are in DEV; library Equipment Desk Kit (DeskHeader, ConfirmDialog, DeskRules, LibraryTestScreen) is built and published as version 1.0; Equipment Desk (phone) is in the Equipment Desk solution with the Open loans screen; CT-0043 is open and overdue for alex.demo@contoso.com plus a second open loan. Press Enter'

screens.name: library-studio
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk > Equipment Desk Kit > Edit
Components tab: DeskHeader, ConfirmDialog, DeskRules
Select DeskHeader: custom properties Title, ShowBack, Accent and OnBack (Event)
Play LibraryTestScreen: back arrow shows 'OnBack', Open dialog > Cancel shows 'OnCancel'
Show Save with version notes ('1.0 first version') and Publish
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: import-components
steps: Open 'Equipment Desk (phone)' in Studio
Settings > Updates > New: Enhanced component properties is On
Insert > Get more components > Equipment Desk Kit > Select all > Import
On LoansScreen select hdrLoans: show its properties
Select the gallery label: Color formula uses deskRules.StateColor(...)
Show Library components in the Insert pane
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: app-return
steps: Play the published app in the browser (phone layout), Open loans: header with the back arrow
Returned on CT-0043: dialog 'Mark as returned?'
Cancel, then Returned again > Mark returned: banner 'CT-0043 is back and available', row gone
Open the model-driven Equipment Desk app: CT-0043 status Available
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: library-update
steps: In the library change DeskHeader Accent default to RGBA(0, 59, 112, 1)
Save with version notes '1.1 darker header' and Publish; wait up to five minutes
Open the app for editing: 'Updates available' > Review (shows the note) > Update
Show Insert > Library components > Check for updates as the second way
Show the darker header; Save and publish the app
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: reset CT-0043 (clear Returned on, status On loan) if later episodes need it overdue; the library and the app changes stay for episode 8.'
